identity.milo: Milo is one slender upright bipedal wool-felt mouse with a warm taupe-grey body, elongated pale-cream belly, large youthful rounded head, smooth felt crown continuous with the head surface, two very large round ears with dusty-rose interiors and stitched grey rims, large round dark-brown irises with cream sclera and small consistent highlights, curved brown brows, a tiny brown nose, short cream muzzle, fine pale whiskers, central face seam, two slim arms with rounded paws, two slim legs and one long thin rosy-taupe tail attached at the lower back. Preserve the approved skull/torso ratio, slim waist, muzzle, ear spacing, eye spacing and limb thickness. The smooth crown has ordinary short felt texture without a separate hairstyle.
identity.leo: Leo is one compact sturdy quadrupedal wool-felt lion with golden-ochre body, broad pale-cream muzzle and chest, short thick legs, four large rounded paws, large round dark-brown irises with cream sclera, curved brown brows, small brown triangular nose on a soft warm bridge, fine pale whiskers, central face seam, small round pink-inner ears and one golden tail with a rust-orange tip. His full circular burnt-orange/rust mane has the approved large volume and layered fuzzy wool locks around face and upper chest. Preserve the approved muzzle, eye spacing, leg thickness, mane outline and intrinsic palette.

style: Handcrafted wool-felt stop-motion storybook miniature; softly stuffed matte forms, tactile looped wool fibres, fine visible stitching and gentle handmade irregularities. Warm child-friendly palette, soft directional illumination, clear subject silhouettes and a softly out-of-focus distant background. Keep the subject face, contact points and ground plane sharply readable.
relative_scale: Milo = one third of Leo neutral standing height at equal depth; never compare with lying pose box height

geometry_profiles.solo: Fixed normal-height camera, 16:9. Milo's proposed neutral standing height is 0.30 of frame height; planted baseline y=0.84. Use pose-calibrated silhouette height, keeping skull and torso at that scale. Use the endpoint-specified centre; when it is inherited, keep the exact approved previous position. A new location such as the burrow requires a measured doorway-relative centre before approval.
geometry_profiles.run: Fixed normal-height side camera, 16:9. Milo's neutral standing-equivalent height is 0.30 of frame height and travel baseline y=0.82. Keep depth constant through horizontal travel. Preserve head scale through the gait, including airborne phases; screen x is specified by each endpoint.
geometry_profiles.tree_pair: Fixed normal-height wide camera, 16:9. Leo's neutral standing-equivalent height is 0.54 of frame height, centre x=0.72 and paw plane y=0.84. Milo's equivalent height is 0.18 at the same depth. Lying Leo keeps the same anatomical scale. Milo starts left and reaches the extended paw at x=0.54, y=0.84; later conversation position x=0.52. Keep ample mane and tail margins.
geometry_profiles.trap_pair: Fixed normal-height wide camera, 16:9. Leo centre x=0.60 with neutral standing-equivalent height 0.54 and ground baseline y=0.86; Milo height 0.18 at the same depth, conversation centre x=0.35. Net initially spans Leo and the ground. Bite target R01 is the near-left strand at approximately x=0.43,y=0.71; measure/freeze the exact point on the approved start. Safe mouse position is x=0.24,y=0.86. Preserve planted anatomy and background scale.
geometry_profiles.portrait_milo: Fixed normal-height portrait crop of the approved scene, 16:9. Milo centred x=0.50, eye-line y=0.43, proposed skull width excluding ears 0.32 of frame width. Keep both ears and muzzle legible; lower paws/tail stay outside the crop. Match head size, eye-line and neck seam in both endpoints. Same soft blurred scene crop, without newly revealed landmarks.
geometry_profiles.portrait_leo: Fixed normal-height portrait crop of the approved scene, 16:9. Leo centred x=0.50, eye-line y=0.43, proposed skull width excluding mane 0.34 of frame width. Keep the mane outline, ears and muzzle intact; paws/tail remain below or behind the crop. Match skull scale and eye-line through expressions. Same soft blurred scene crop.
geometry_profiles.contact: Fixed normal-height close two-shot cropped from the approved great-tree scene. Match both characters' established body proportions and depth; Milo remains one third of Leo's standing-equivalent height. The crop magnifies both equally. Nose/paw contacts and both faces are readable, with no camera motion inside the clip.
geometry_profiles.bite: Fixed normal-height close two-shot cropped from the approved net scene around strand R01 and Milo's face/paws. Magnify both characters and net by one shared crop; do not resize Milo independently. Two neighbouring knots K-left and K-right bracket the single bite point. Leo's recognizable face is softly behind the rope; both of Milo's holding paws and the bite remain readable.
geometry_profiles.empty: Fixed 16:9 camera at the approved plate framing; no cast. Preserve every static landmark and the complete field of view.

stream_afternoon.description: A felt stream runs left-to-right beside low berry bushes, rounded trees, grass and a hollow log on the right bank. Warm afternoon light from the left. Preserve bank outline, log, red-berry bushes and all rocks.
stream_afternoon.ambient: Stream surface ripples continuously left-to-right at low amplitude; leaf and grass tips move softly in a light breeze. Banks, trunks, log and rocks remain fixed.

stream_sunset.description: The exact stream-bank geometry and camera of the afternoon plate in low warm sunset light. The hollow log, berries, rocks and bank contours occupy identical positions.
stream_sunset.ambient: Use the same low-amplitude water flow and leaf/grass-tip breeze as the afternoon stream scene. Banks, trunks, log and rocks remain fixed; the sunset light stays constant within the shot.

fork_sunset.description: One fork: the safe left path curves toward a meadow; the shortcut on the right leads into closer darker trees. Sunset light. Path boundaries, tree trunks and horizon stay fixed.
fork_sunset.ambient: Soft local leaf/grass-tip motion only; visible distant clouds drift slowly left-to-right. Trunks, roots, path and rocks remain fixed.

shortcut_dusk.description: A side view of the mossy shortcut at dusk. Preserve the stone, fallen branch and stump in their established order, with a clear horizontal running lane.
shortcut_dusk.ambient: Soft leaf and grass tips stir gently. The stone, branch, stump, tree trunks and ground remain fixed.

tree_dusk.description: Leo's great tree with its broad trunk on the right, exposed roots, path across the foreground and small flowers, at blue-orange dusk. Preserve the trunk, roots, horizon and path.
tree_dusk.ambient: Canopy leaf edges and grass tips flutter gently; any visible stream ripples consistently and clouds drift slowly. Trunk, roots, rocks and camera remain fixed.

tree_day.description: The exact great-tree setup in warm daylight: trunk on the right, same roots, path and flowers, unchanged camera and landforms.
tree_day.ambient: Gentle canopy leaf-edge and grass-tip motion, subtle corresponding leaf shadows; visible water ripples. Tree skeleton, roots, rocks and sun direction remain fixed.

tree_sky.description: An approved upward cutaway crop/view of the great tree canopy against dusk sky and first stars. Preserve branch silhouettes and sky framing.
tree_sky.ambient: Canopy leaf edges flutter, clouds drift slowly left-to-right and stars twinkle subtly. Main branches and camera remain steady.

home_night.description: Milo's distinct low grassy-bank burrow among roots and rounded stones beside a small stream, a round wooden door and tiny warm lantern, under blue night sky. This is a low bank home, not Leo's giant trunk.
home_night.ambient: Subtle stream ripples and small leaf-tip movement; steady warm lantern light. Door frame, bank, roots, rocks and distant trunks stay fixed.

trap_morning.description: The net sequence's straight forest path with red/green leaves, purple-grey rounded rocks and tall trees in warm morning light. Use this actual set, not the separate curved misty L-16 plate. Preserve the path vanishing point, two rock silhouettes and trunk centres.
trap_morning.ambient: Low-amplitude leaf and fern-tip motion with subtle leaf shadows. All tree trunks, stems, roots, rocks, path edges and camera remain fixed. Leaves touching ropes retain their attachment/occlusion relationship.

run_morning.description: A side-view forest run with foreground roots, a middle bush and a low branch, warm morning shafts and a clear right-to-left travel lane.
run_morning.ambient: Gentle leaf/grass tips and soft leaf shadows move. Roots, branch, stems, trunks and ground geometry remain fixed.

net_rules: Exactly one net. R01 parts at its recorded bite between K-left/K-right. Both ends persist. Damage never reverses. After release overhead is empty. After freedom net remains behind Leo. Camera cuts retain world state.

mouth_rules.alternative: mouth, bounded unsynchronised motion; quiet lead/tail
mouth_rules.functional: gnawing or nibbling; dedicated approved contact mouth plus closed reaction backup
mouth_rules.milo_teeth: draft: two small rounded cream upper incisors for gnawing; approve before use
mouth_rules.leo_mouth: rounded dark warm interior and small muted-pink tongue, without fangs
